builds.name: Time Tracker CLI
builds.purpose: Lightning-fast time tracking for productivity analysis and project time allocation visibility
features: Real-time session tracking with start/stop and live duration display
Quick retroactive logging for completed work sessions with project categorization
Smart project system with 5 defaults plus custom project support with colors
Comprehensive analytics with daily/weekly/monthly breakdowns and time distribution percentages
Terminal-native workflow with color-coded output and NST timezone awareness
Historical data preservation with searchable JSON format for long-term analysis

builds.name: Meeting Notes CLI
builds.purpose: Lightning-fast meeting note capture and organization from terminal for systematic meeting management
features: Smart templates for 1-on-1s, standups, planning, retrospectives
Action item tracking with ownership, due dates, completion status
Decision documentation with searchable timestamp history
Powerful search across all meeting content and attendees
NST timezone aware timestamps and date handling
Terminal-native workflow with zero context switching
